Accept Deny ABOUT BILLY NIGHTINGALE A BRIEF INTRO I’m Billy Nightingale, a web designer and developer based in Capbreton, which is part of the Landes region in France. I help small local businesses create modern, high-performing websites that are fast, search-engine friendly, and designed to support real business growth. With a background in mechanical engineering and a strong focus on problem solving, I combine technical development with thoughtful design to build websites that are both functional and visually engaging. My work ranges from WordPress websites for local businesses to custom web applications and digital tools designed to simplify operations and improve online presence. Jump back and check out my projects or learn more LEARN MORE PROJECTS THE JOURNEY My engineering and web development journey BEng Motorsport Engineering Mechatronics Engineer Bac +2 Web Development Billy Nightingale Web Studio WHAT I DO I build websites, systems and applications WEBSITE DESIGN Designing websites for small to medium size businesses, with the use of cutting edge technology like Figma and relume AI to provide the highest quality design Creating assets like SVGs, icons and editing images with Affinity and Adobe to enhance the visual experience SERVICES PROJECTS SEO & PERFORMANCE OPTIMISATION Optimise performance and SEO to drive traffic and increase revenue, I strive to provide the fastest most accessible sites with great user experience. SERVICES PROJECTS WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT Full-stack web development, developing products and tools. I develop website using tool such as Wordpress and Elementor but also full-stack application through programming with languages such as JavaScript, frameworks like React and Node.JS SERVICES PROJECTS THE PROCESS Depending on the project I have a four phase approach, discovery, design and develop PHASE 1 Discovery In the discovery phase I have a discussion with my client and study their requirements and issues, I create mood boards and we discuss design options and available solutions to their issues. This includes research into competitors and design direction. Expand PHASE 2 Design In the design phase, I present a style guide with a selection of fonts pairs and a colour palette with low-fidelity wireframes, once approved we move to high-fidelity wireframes. Expand PHASE 3 Development In the development phase, I begin developing the project and optimising it for production, this includes building out a fully customised system using reusable components and optimising images and fonts for web performance, creating a custom layout system with equal and fluid spacing. All of my designs are crafted to be fully responsive and fluid, they're optimised for all major devices. Expand PHASE 4 Deployment The deployment phase is the stage I connect the domain and ensure the site is secure with SSL, then launch the site and begin to optimise the SEO and ensure stability via test using various tools like Google Search Console and Ahrefs auditing, I run Lighthouse performance tests to ensure page speed and accessibility are optimum. Expand THE TECHNOLOGIES AND TOOLS The technologies I choose for a project depend on the scope and requirements of the website or application, I work with the latest cutting edge technology, but I always choose what is practical for the size and budget of the project, some of the main technologies I work with are Project Management Google Drive Notion Trello ClickUp Design Relume Figma Affinity Unicorn studio Development Wordpress Elementor Pro HTML CSS JavaScript React NodeJS MySQL Deployment Hostinger Netlify Pro Railway LOCATION CAPBRETON & HOSSEGOR I’m located in the beautiful town of Capbreton, which is part of the Landes region in France. Primarily, I work with local clients like restaurants, healthcare providers, beverage produces and local businesses. But I am of course available for remote work. I take a lot of care in producing high quality work, which includes SEO optimised website's, focused on location, checkout some of my top ranking projects PERSONAL MY INTERESTS When I’m not working on client projects, I’m usually programming and building tools or applications. In my leisure time I’m very social and active, my favourite sports are snowboarding and surfing, I’ve travelled all over the world practising these sports. I'm also a qualified personal trainer and a snowboard instructor. # Security headers, sent with every file:
# - nosniff: the browser must use the file type the server states, not guess it
# - X-Frame-Options: other sites cannot display these pages inside a frame
# - Referrer-Policy: other sites are told which site a visitor came from, not
#   which page
# - Permissions-Policy: the site, and anything embedded in it, cannot ask for
#   the camera, microphone or location
# - Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: the list of places the pages may load
#   things from. Everything comes from this site, except the analytics that
#   load after cookie consent: Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics, and the
#   Google Ads addresses that Analytics calls for remarketing and conversions.
#   The Google addresses are the ones in Google's own guide:
#   https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/security/guides/csp
#   A policy cannot say "google in any country", so each country is listed:
#   .com, .fr, .es and .co.uk. Add more if visitors from elsewhere matter.
#   "Report-Only" means the browser only logs what the policy would block, in
#   its console, and blocks nothing. Once the live site shows no reports,
#   rename the header to Content-Security-Policy to enforce it.
#   'unsafe-inline' is needed because Astro and Cloudflare put small scripts
#   directly in the page.
/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=600, must-revalidate
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin

# About Billy Nightingale — Web Designer & Developer in Capbreton, Landes

> Billy Nightingale is a web designer and developer based in Capbreton, Landes, France, near Hossegor and the Pays Basque. He helps small and medium-sized businesses create modern, fast, search-engine-friendly websites, web applications and digital tools designed to support business growth.

**Website:** [billynightingale.com](https://www.billynightingale.com/)  
**About page:** [billynightingale.com/about](https://www.billynightingale.com/about)  
**French-language page:** [À propos](https://www.billynightingale.com/fr/a-propos)

## Background

Billy has a background in mechanical engineering and approaches web design and development with a focus on practical problem-solving. He combines technical development with thoughtful design to create websites that are functional, visually engaging and tailored to each client's goals.

His work ranges from WordPress websites for local businesses to custom web applications and digital tools that simplify operations and strengthen a business's online presence.

### Professional journey

- **BEng Motorsport Engineering** — engineering education.
- **Mechatronics Engineer** — professional engineering background.
- **Bac +2 Web Development** — web development training.
- **Billy Nightingale Web Studio** — independent web design and development work.

## What Billy Does

### Website Design

Billy designs websites for small and medium-sized businesses, with an emphasis on visual identity, usability and engaging experiences. His design work uses tools such as Figma and Relume, along with Affinity and Adobe tools for image editing, SVGs, icons and other visual assets.

### SEO and Website Performance Optimisation

Billy works on website performance, search engine optimisation (SEO), accessibility and user experience to help businesses improve online visibility and provide a faster, easier experience for visitors.

### Website and Application Development

Billy builds websites, web applications and digital tools. His work includes WordPress and Elementor websites, as well as full-stack applications using JavaScript, React, Node.js and related technologies.

For more information about available work, see [Web Design, Development and SEO Services](https://www.billynightingale.com/services).

## Project Process

The approach varies by project, but typically follows four phases:

### 1. Discovery

Billy discusses the client's goals, requirements and challenges, researches competitors, explores possible solutions and design directions, and creates mood boards to establish the project's direction.

### 2. Design

Billy presents a style guide with typography and colour options, creates low-fidelity wireframes, and develops high-fidelity designs once the initial direction is approved.

### 3. Development

Billy builds the website or application using reusable components and a responsive layout system. This includes optimising images and fonts for web performance and adapting the experience to major device sizes.

### 4. Deployment

Billy connects the domain, configures SSL and launches the website. He then checks stability, SEO, performance and accessibility using tools such as Google Search Console, Ahrefs and Lighthouse.

## Technologies and Tools

The technology stack depends on the project's scope, requirements and budget. Tools listed on the About page include:

- **Project management:** Google Drive, Notion, Trello, ClickUp.
- **Design:** Relume, Figma, Affinity, Unicorn Studio.
- **Development:** WordPress, Sanity, Elementor Pro, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Astro, Node.js, MySQL
- **Deployment and hosting:** Hostinger, Netlify Pro, Railway.

## Location and Clients

Billy is based in **Capbreton (40130), Landes, France**, close to Hossegor and the Pays Basque. He primarily works with local businesses, including restaurants, healthcare providers, beverage producers and other independent businesses. Remote projects are also possible.

He focuses on creating websites suited to a client's audience and location, including local SEO and performance optimisation.

Related pages:

- [Website Design and Development in Landes](https://www.billynightingale.com/website-development-landes)
- [Selected Projects](https://www.billynightingale.com/#projects)

## Personal Interests
